queries.title: Job searches
queries.description: Roles or keywords, one per line, e.g. data analyst, registered nurse, "react developer".

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Cities, states or countries, e.g. Austin, TX / London / Remote. Every query runs for every location. Leave empty to let Google pick from the query.

maxJobs.title: Max jobs
maxJobs.description: Total unique jobs to return across all searches.

expandQueries.title: Expand queries to reach more jobs
expandQueries.description: Google shows 10 jobs per search. With this on, the actor also searches variants (remote, senior, entry level, contract...) and keeps going while they add new jobs. Turn off to get just the top 10 per search.

employmentTypes.title: Employment types
employmentTypes.description: Keep only these types. Empty = any.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Keep only jobs posted in the last N days. 0 = any date. Jobs with no posted date are dropped when this is set.

includeDescription.title: Include full description
includeDescription.description: The full job description text. Turn off for smaller rows.

country.title: Google country
country.description: Two-letter country code for Google (gl), e.g. us, gb, ca, au, in, de.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language (hl), e.g. en, de, fr, es.
